app.title: settling-map

legend.title: Median price, €/m²
legend.priceOnlyNote: Textures describe the reliability of the price.

inspector.title: Place details
inspector.empty: Select a commune to see its median price and how solid the figure is.

confidence.0: No sales kept in the period. A lack of data does not mean a low price.
confidence.1: Few sales: treat this figure with caution.
confidence.2: A moderate number of sales: a fairly solid figure.
confidence.3: A high number of sales: a solid figure.
confidence.4: Alsace-Moselle and Mayotte: these sales are not in the DVF database. A lack of data does not mean a low price.

inspector.disclaimer: Indicative: median sale price divided by built surface. It is not a valuation of any property.
inspector.windowWide: Period widened to {{months}} months because of few sales
inspector.distanceNote: Straight-line distances from a point in the commune, not travel times.
inspector.noIndicators: No other indicators at this level.

sources.title: Sources and limits
sources.method: Price per m² is the median of house and flat sales (one dwelling per sale, off-plan sales excluded) divided by built surface. Land sold with a house is included in its price. Sales are aggregated by commune: no individual sale is shown.
sources.limits: Départements 57, 67, 68 and Mayotte are not covered by the DVF database. The data lags by about one semester.
sources.creditsDvf: Property transactions: DGFiP / Etalab, Licence Ouverte v2.0
sources.creditsIgn: Administrative boundaries: IGN, Licence Ouverte v2.0
sources.creditsOsm: Basemap: © OpenStreetMap contributors, OpenMapTiles, via OpenFreeMap
sources.privacy: No account, no cookies, no tracking. Map tiles are loaded from OpenFreeMap and Cloudflare.
sources.methodExtra: Seismic zone: regulatory zoning by commune (Géorisques). Distances: shortest straight line from a point in the commune to the nearest facility in INSEE's permanent facilities base; they are not travel times and a single point stands for the whole commune.
sources.creditsInsee: Facilities: INSEE, permanent facilities base, Licence Ouverte v2.0
sources.creditsGeorisques: Seismic zoning: Géorisques (BRGM, ministry of ecological transition), Licence Ouverte
